name: review
wording: A judgment of one change by someone who did not write it, against the change and the acceptance criteria and examples it is reviewed against; it approves or asks for changes, naming each finding, and never repairs the work. A contrived way around a check is future work on that check, never a finding against the change. Whether and when a change is reviewed is Ship, Show or Ask in its established meaning and nothing beyond it: Ship joins it unreviewed, Show joins it then has it reviewed, Ask has it reviewed before it joins; there is no second reviewer. Where the operator asks to review a change before it joins, that change is under Ask with the operator as its one reviewer, and no agent reviews it as well. A doubt about what a concept or an example means goes to the architect as a meaning question.
reason: The operator: the design state a session reads was long human prose restating facts across concepts and carrying decisions with their situations; its reader is a model, so the state is the design alone, each concept as its established name and residue, and decisions and their reasons are history. Restated as its established name and residue, standalone, each fact in the one concept it belongs to, with the meaning standing decisions carried folded in.
